# Read the CSV
df = pd.read_csv('csv/yearmonth.csv')

aug_2012 = df[df['Date'] == 201208]
print(f"Total rows in Aug 2012: {len(aug_2012)}")
print(f"Unique CustomerIDs in Aug 2012: {aug_2012['CustomerID'].nunique()}")
print(f"Sample CustomerIDs in Aug 2012: {aug_2012['CustomerID'].head(20).tolist()}")

matching = aug_2012[aug_2012['CustomerID'].isin(target_customers)]
print(f"\nMatching customers from target list: {len(matching)}")
if len(matching) > 0:
    print(matching[['CustomerID', 'Consumption']].head())
else:
    print("No matches found for target customers in Aug 2012")
